products.name: LMSYS Arena Models
products.note: Model evaluation platform; crowdsourced benchmarking; research transparency; no production use

profile_text.body:
LMSYS operates the Arena AI platform at lmarena.ai, which the site describes as an AI ranking and LLM leaderboard where users can chat with, compare, and vote on AI models. The platform supports crowdsourced, real-world evaluation of large language models as well as image and code models, with the stated goal of shaping a public leaderboard and advancing AI research. The site notes that user conversations and certain personal information may be shared with relevant AI providers or disclosed publicly, and that conversations are also used for automated evaluation in which prompts are later sent to AI providers to score and compare their models.

The held facts identify LMSYS as a nonprofit organization, with its primary tracked product being LMSYS Arena Models, categorized as a model evaluation platform built around crowdsourced benchmarking and research transparency rather than production use. No litigation, MCP servers, SEC filings, or patent records are associated with the organization in the available data.
